meta_description: Darren Hulme is a painter and decorator serving Birmingham and the West Midlands. Interior and exterior work, competitive rates, free quotes.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full home redecorating, we transform your space with precision and care.
services_heading: Interior & Exterior Painting Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete redecoration, we handle residential and commercial projects with attention to detail and professional finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep surfaces properly and use quality paints to ensure a finish that lasts years.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with expert exterior work. We handle gutters, fascias, soffits, and render finish to protect and enhance your property.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging and removal. Create impact with patterned or textured features that transform a room instantly.

services.title: Commercial & Office Redecorating
services.desc: Keep disruption minimal with flexible scheduling. We work around your business hours and deliver professional finishes for a professional impression.

services.title: Furniture Upcycling & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Refresh tired furniture with expert spray finishing and hand-painting. Bespoke colours and finishes tailored to your home style.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Proper surface prep is everything. We fill cracks, sand, prime, and repair to guarantee a flawless final result every time.

about_pullquote: A good decorator earns your trust one coat at a time.
about_para_1: I'm Darren Hulme, and I've been painting and decorating homes across Birmingham and the West Midlands for over 20 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a reputation built on reliability, quality finishes, and fair pricing. I take pride in turning up on time, doing the job right, and leaving your home spotless.
about_para_2: My customers come back because I listen to what they want and deliver it without the corporate nonsense. Whether it's a quick interior refresh or a full commercial redecoration, I approach every project with the same care I'd give my own home. References from previous clients are always available, and I'm happy to discuss your project before you commit to anything.

reviews.text: Darren came round to quote for our lounge and hallway. Really professional, didn't try to oversell us, and got the job done on time and to a high standard. The finish is brilliant and he left the place clean. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with our exterior woodwork — it needed proper prep and multiple coats. Darren explained what had to be done and didn't cut corners. Three months on and it still looks fresh. Best money we've spent on the house.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Used Darren for our office redecoration. Worked around our hours, minimal fuss, and the result was perfect. Our clients commented on how good the place looks. Booking him again next quarter.
reviews.author: James P.
